notes.title: Big Update Version 0.3.0 is out!
notes.content:
After a long time we finally released version 0.3.0. There were many difficulties in the development from version 2.5 to 3.0, among others. because of corrupt files. But we have now made it and can now present you a lot of news and improvements! We thank you for your patience and wish you lots of fun in our park!

[u]News:[/u]
[*] A completely new system was developed:
[*] Guests would now like to drive bumper cars, try bull-riding or take a relaxed lap with the Western Express. (Alpha)

[*] New game over screen will appear if you do not behave properly. For example, when operating the bull, be careful to press STOP in good time if the guest falls down, otherwise this can have serious consequences!

[*] Westernexpress has been revised:
[olist]
[*] Getting out possible while driving
[*] When you get off, you are now right next to the train
[*] The train can now be stopped while driving
[*] New sound effects
[*] Improvements to the train wheels
[/olist]
[/ List]
[*] New graphics system

[*] Exchange and improvement of plants and animals

[u]Bug fixes:[/u]

[*] Bugs that caused the game to crash have been fixed

[*] Collision on trees for humans and animals added
[/ List]


And MANY more things!


[b]We hope you enjoy our park![/b]

notes.title: News for the January 2020 update!
notes.content:
We'd like to tell you what's new in the next update!

We have fixed the faulty files and can now promise that the next update will be released in January 2020. One of the big innovations will affect the guests. They are now interested in taking part in some rides (beta, see screenshot).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34384938/548dbc683f1fd686f77bbf417296efd11e6a5370.png[/img]

We also fixed a few bugs and animation errors for the guests. And work is also being done on the railroad. For example, improving boarding and alighting or operating the locomotive.

We are really looking forward to the next update and wish you all a happy new year 2020!

notes.title: Update 0.2.5
notes.content:
After some time we finally release the next update.
Now the white water course can be served and our park has grown again.
Unfortunately, we have problems with shadows in dark areas. We hope that we get this repaired soon
Have fun with the new update and the Wildwasserbahn.

notes.title: Update 0.2.0 + new Trailer
notes.content:
Hello!
We have now released the update to version 0.2.0. With this update we are laying another foundation for future functions. The most important changes are listed here.

In general:
- New subject area: Märchendorf
- New fairy tale added: Frau Holle (press E to start)
- Guests added(Please note! This feature is in the alpha version. This will be extended or improved.)
- Revision and adaptation of the game world
- added smaller objects
- small vegetation improvements
Rides:
- fairy tale whirl added (control function will be added with the next update)
Are there any further questions or problems? Then write a comment here or send us an e-mail: help.tpw@gmail.com
